stem.text: The diagram shows one way of testing the effect of an antibiotic on bacteria.

stem.alt: Two petri dish diagrams joined by an arrow labelled grown for 5 days, with labels for colonies of bacteria, nutrient agar, disc of filter paper soaked in antibiotic, and diameter of zone measured every day for 5 days.

stem.text: The table shows the results of testing five different types of bacteria.
Zones of less than $13.0\,\text{mm}$ show the presence of resistant bacteria.
Which statement can be supported by this data?

A.text: All the types of bacteria become resistant to antibiotics over time.

B.text: Only types 2, 3 and 4 of the bacteria show resistance to the antibiotic.

C.text: The antibiotic can be used to treat types 1 and 3 only.

D.text: Type 5 of the bacteria can never become resistant to the antibiotic.
